_help: Linux/macOS counterpart of dxf-preview.windows.json, using netpng's dxf2png (github.com/tsnomura/netpng - cargo build or its install.sh; needs dxf2png on PATH). Rasterizes a DXF drawing's model space (lines, arcs, circles, ellipses, polylines, splines, blocks; no text) to PNG with the longer side at 1024 px, writing the file itself with -o. DXF is text, so Quick Look also offers the rendered/source toggle for it. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
